textureStrategy.format: portable embedded PNG in source GLB plus editable PNGs under source/textures/
textureStrategy.uvStrategy: Each render mesh has unique UV0 from smart project plus a scaled UV1. LOD0 unique albedo/ORM/normal maps are cage-baked (high duplicate, inflate 0.055 m, Cycles selected-to-active). Checker/stretch review remains G3 and is not a self-pass.
